system.description:
• Effect: Each time you enter a rage, choose one style. It lasts for that rage.
  • Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage
  • Brutal: once per round, when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save against your Class Save DC)
  • Terrifying: once per rage, use Intimidate as part of an attack instead of your action
  • 8th level: choose two styles each time you rage
